perplexity.description:
EP One marks Paul Draper's debut solo release following his departure from Mansun, arriving in 2016 as his first record for the progressive rock label Kscope. The EP introduces Draper's solo artistic direction with the lead single "Feeling My Heart Run Slow" accompanied by three B-sides, establishing a foundation for his subsequent solo work that would culminate in the full-length album Spooky Action the following year.

The release represents a significant milestone in Draper's career, initiating a prolific solo period after Mansun ceased touring in 2002. As the opening statement of his Kscope partnership, EP One positioned Draper within the progressive rock landscape, blending electronic and rock elements that would characterize his broader solo output. The EP was released in limited edition vinyl format with a stamp-numbered pressing and included a free digital download.

While specific critical reception details are limited in available documentation, EP One's success as a launching point is evidenced by Draper's continued output with Kscope, including two additional EPs released later in 2016 and 2017, and the subsequent full-length album Spooky Action, which earned a nomination for Album of the Year at the Progressive Music Awards. The EP established the sonic and thematic framework that would define Draper's solo identity in the years following.
